offering_description.value: Rayonier grows and harvests timber on managed forests and sells standing timber and logs to wood processors. It also manufactures lumber and plywood for building-materials buyers. It sells rural land and developed lots and leases land for recreation and other uses.

primary_products.value: standing timber and logs; softwood lumber; plywood; rural land; developed lots

primary_services.value: recreational land leasing; land leasing for renewable energy projects

customer_segment.value: B2B: Sawmills, pulp and paper mills, building-materials wholesalers, homebuilders, land developers and renewable energy developers; B2C: Rural property buyers, residential lot buyers and recreational land users

end_markets.value: forest products manufacturing; pulp and paper; building construction; rural real estate and recreation; renewable energy

revenue_model.value: product sales: Standing timber, delivered logs, lumber and plywood; other: Sales of timberland, rural acreage and developed lots; rental or leasing: Hunting and recreation access and land for renewable energy projects
revenue_model.category: product sales; other; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: Grows trees and supplies standing timber and logs to sawmills and pulp mills; asset operator: Manages timberlands for timber buyers and develops or leases property for land buyers and tenants; OEM / manufacturer: Processes logs into lumber and plywood for building-materials wholesalers and dealers
value_chain_position.category: raw materials; asset operator; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: US national: U.S. timberlands concentrated in the South and Northwest, with wood products sold nationally

specialization.value: related lines: Timberland management, lumber and plywood manufacturing, land sales and development, and land leasing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Timber sales teams serving mills and wood products sales teams serving wholesale buyers; distributors / dealers: Building-materials wholesalers and lumber dealers; agents / brokers: Real estate brokers marketing rural acreage and development properties; online: Company websites listing land for sale and recreational leases
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; agents / brokers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: State forest practices rules, Clean Water Act requirements, sawmill air permits and OSHA workplace safety standards

notes: The current extent of export sales is uncertain.
